name: Sample Willow House
includes: Private event space for up to 150 guests, ceremony lawn, indoor rain backup, tables, chairs and onsite host.
setup: Two-hour access before doors open. Final floor plan and insurance documents due 14 days before the event.

name: Sample Bright Frame Photography
includes: One photographer, six hours of coverage, a planning call, 400 edited images and a private delivery gallery.
setup: Share your timeline and group portrait list one week ahead. Allow 30 minutes for family portraits.

name: Sample Petal & Stem Studio
includes: One ceremony arrangement, eight table centerpieces, two bouquets, delivery, installation and collection.
setup: Vases need level surfaces and shelter from direct heat. Floral installation takes 90 minutes.

name: Sample Night Shift Sound
includes: DJ and MC, five hours of music, sound system, two wireless microphones, dance-floor lighting and playlist consultation.
setup: A covered 8-by-8-foot setup area and one dedicated 120V outlet. Sound check starts 60 minutes before guests arrive.

name: Sample Honeycrumb Bakery
includes: Two-tier celebration cake, 60 mini desserts, menu tasting, delivery and dessert-table styling.
setup: Provide a sturdy table indoors and refrigeration when requested. Allergen details are confirmed before baking.

name: Sample Soft Light Beauty
includes: Hair styling and makeup for four people, one consultation, lashes, touch-up kits and onsite service.
setup: Allow 60–75 minutes per person. Provide chairs, outlets and a well-lit getting-ready room.

name: Sample Flash Social Booth
includes: An attended open-air booth, backdrop, custom print design, unlimited sessions and a digital gallery.
setup: A level sheltered 10-by-10-foot area, one outlet and Wi-Fi where available. Setup takes 45 minutes.

name: Sample Gathered Details
includes: Design consultation, ten tabletop settings, welcome signage, a focal backdrop, setup and next-day collection.
setup: Venue access two hours before the event. Confirm installation permissions and table measurements in advance.

name: Sample Wonder Hour Entertainment
includes: Two hours of hosted close-up magic and interactive activities, a planning call and all performance equipment.
setup: Provide a sheltered performance area and confirm guest ages, accessibility needs and the running order.
